cases.description: Sign in with a correct email and password
cases.preCondition: A Customer account exists and is active
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/login with the correct email and password of the Customer account
cases.expectedResult: Returns 200 with an access token, a refresh token and the user profile

cases.description: Sign in with a wrong password
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/login with the correct email but a wrong password
cases.expectedResult: Returns 401 with a generic message that does not reveal whether the email or the password was wrong
cases.expectedMessageContains: Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng

cases.description: Sign in with an email that is not registered
cases.preCondition: The email does not exist in the system
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/login with an email that was never registered
cases.expectedResult: Returns 401 with exactly the same message as the wrong-password case, so registered emails cannot be enumerated
cases.expectedMessageContains: Email hoặc mật khẩu không đúng

cases.description: Sign in with an empty password
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/login with an empty password string
cases.expectedResult: Returns 401 without raising a server error

cases.description: Sign in with the email in a different letter case
cases.preCondition: A Customer account exists with a lowercase email
cases.procedure: Send POST /api/Auth/login with the email written entirely in uppercase
cases.expectedResult: Returns 200 because the email is normalised to lowercase before lookup

cases.description: Call the current-user endpoint without signing in
cases.procedure: Send GET /api/Auth/me without a bearer token

cases.description: Call the current-user endpoint with a valid token
cases.preCondition: Signed in as the Customer account
cases.procedure: Send GET /api/Auth/me with the Customer bearer token
cases.expectedResult: Returns 200 with the profile of the signed-in account
